summary: Complete all levels by scribing and get ready to become a riddle master!
description:
Welcome to the unique world of Draw Puzzle! For those who love to draw, a new draw puzzle game is waiting for you! 

Draw Puzzle is specially designed for those who love to draw and play with puzzles. This new Draw Puzzle game is a combination of drawing and puzzle. Combining these two features, Draw Puzzle guarantees that you will have a wonderful time while you are playing the game!

From quick sketches to fully finished artwork, this sketch game goes where your creativity takes you. Draw Puzzle is a sketching, scribble, painting, doodling and drawing game for anyone who loves to draw.

In this game, new shapes will appear in each level that you have to complete by drawing them. With each new level you pass, the difficulty will increase and the game will challenge you! You have to pass all the levels and prove your own doodling skills!

Draw Puzzle is a game that appeals to people of all ages. When you come back from school, after a tiring work day, when you want to take time for yourself after taking care of the children, it will be waiting for you to give you a pleasant time in your boring moments.

If you are someone who likes to paint and doodle, this game is for you. You will get addicted to this immersive drawing game and you will never get tired of playing this game! If you're ready to challenge yourself and your skills, start to draw it!

Features of the Game:
-Improves drawing ability!
-Smart moves in drawing puzzles!
-Helps improve hand-eye coordination!
-Show your sketching skills!
-Hundreds of doodling puzzles to solve!
-Contributes to the development of attention!
-Quick draw for all ages of puzzle games lovers!

When you are bored with the tiring thoughts of daily life, Draw Puzzle will help you to relax and save you from your boring world. Those who trust their paint and scribble skills and those who want to combine drawing with puzzle when bored should join the colorful world of Draw Puzzle!

Draw Puzzle challenges those who are confident in their drawing abilities. If you are one of them, start testing your skills, intelligence and attention. Start drawing something, write your own draw story and make your own challenge!

Draw Puzzle invites you to its own fun world! If you like to doodle, start drawing your own story and get ready to become a draw master!
